title: DEFINE slice 3: rcf define freeze CLI + freeze-record override + hygiene
summary: Ship src/cli/freeze.js implementing 'rcf define freeze' as the only freeze-record writer, wire it into bin/rcf.js and src/cli/help.js, update src/define/freeze-record.js so override is a nullable-required field (loader defaults missing keys to null; validator refuses a body without the key), and replace the ' -- ' double-dash in the readiness CLI stage header and the CHANGELOG TODO-regex line with a colon.
approach: One CLI module composing computeReadiness (REQ-175) and saveFreezeRecord (REQ-172). Ack parsing is a small helper walking --ack and --reason multi-valued arrays in parallel. Ack folding uses the same WARN_WITH_ACK rules gates.js applies at the current tree hash. Counts derivation reuses tree.kindById and parseAcClass; interface counts walk each TAC's interfaces[]. Version reading loads packages/rcf-lite/package.json, src/ruleset/ruleset.json and node_modules/@stravica-ai/rcf-schemas/package.json. --status is a read-only branch that never runs gates. Admissibility refusal is informational per ADR-4124. The freeze-record schema fix requires an override field (nullable): validator throws on missing key, loader defaults missing keys to null on read for backward compatibility, saveFreezeRecord's own validate step catches a caller that forgets to write override.
deliverables: src/cli/freeze.js: HELP, main; --ack (multiple) / --reason (multiple) / --note / --litmus-attested / --status / --json / --help flags; runWithAdmissibilityGate wrap; section 2.5 summary line and --json envelope; counts derivation

src/define/freeze-record.js: validateFreezeRecord requires override (nullable); loadFreezeRecord defaults missing override to null; saveFreezeRecord unchanged (still validates first, which now catches missing override)
src/cli/readiness.js: stage header line uses ': ' between stage / gate / state (no ' -- ')
CHANGELOG.md: TODO regex line rewritten to use ': ' instead of ' -- ', plus slice-3 entries under [Unreleased]
src/cli/help.js: HELP as FREEZE_HELP imported; HELP_MAP.define.freeze wired; DEFINE_HELP listing extended
test/cli/freeze.test.js: CLI tests covering AC-17601-1..6 and AC-17601-8
test/define/freeze-record.test.js: extension test covering AC-17601-7 (override required, loader defaults)
notes: Depth-2 slice: no sub-agents. Chain first, code next, tests last. Dogfood is NOT frozen in the repo (a committed freeze.json would be a product decision); prove the verb on scratch trees and run --status on the dogfood chain as evidence.
